[[File:Thomas McGee 2009 World Championship.jpg|thumb|right|260px|At the [[2009 World Championship]].]]
'''Thomas McGee''' (also published as '''Tom McGee''') is a Colorado Star Wars CCG player. He played at [[December 2001 Greeley tournament]] on 1 December 2001 with YMSYL Garrison drains, according to David Jones's tournament report,<ref name="tr-d3144">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-04-greeley-co-12-1-revised-long-timed3144/ greeley-co-12-1-revised-long-time], DeckTech (David "DavCJ" Jones, 4 December 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-04-greeley-co-12-1-revised-long-timed3144/ GitHub Pages].</ref> finished 3rd at [[February 2002 Parker tournament]],<ref name="tr-d3338">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-06-the-downfall-of-swccg-parker-cod3338/ the-downfall-of-swccg-parker-co], DeckTech (Tom "Divebum101" Meade, 6 February 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-06-the-downfall-of-swccg-parker-cod3338/ GitHub Pages].</ref> and finished Top 4 at [[2002 Houston DPC]] on 14 July 2002 with WYS Raiders, according to Jacob Taylor's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3841">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-07-16-houston-texas-07-14-02-dpc-houstond3841/ houston-texas-07-14-02-dpc-houston], DeckTech (Jacob "Armaedes" Taylor, 16 July 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-07-16-houston-texas-07-14-02-dpc-houstond3841/ GitHub Pages].</ref> He was the tournament director, with a three-judge system, of the [[2008 Northern Colorado Mini-Open]] at Gryphon Cards and Comics in Fort Collins on 27 September 2008.<ref name="pcf-22819-330914">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=330914#330914 Northern Colorado Mini-Open], AnakinSolo, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (25 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080903083837/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=330930 Internet Archive]</ref> He finished 2nd at the [[2008 Wyoming State Championship]] on 17 August 2008 with 8 (+59) and received its Day 2 automatic bid to the [[2008 World Championship]].<ref name="sf-21794-330547">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=330547#p330547 Wyoming States 2008!], Kizakh (Regis Michelena), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (23 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125192329/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21794.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sf-22883-332133">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332133#p332133 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], simone89, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125194535/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t22883.html Internet Archive]</ref>
